columns.name: id
columns.description: Numeric identifier for the entity, stable across the record's lifetime.

columns.name: slug
columns.description: URL-safe identifier used in /crawlers/<slug> and /observed/<slug>.

columns.name: vendor
columns.description: The company or organization that operates or documents the entity.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Display name of the entity.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: One of crawler, fetcher, search_bot, ads_bot, engine, policy_token.

columns.name: purpose
columns.description: One of training, search, user_fetch, ads, mixed, or empty when undocumented.

columns.name: ua_token
columns.description: The token expected in the entity's User-Agent header, when documented.

columns.name: ua_pattern
columns.description: The regular expression the instrument uses to match this entity's User-Agent header.

columns.name: robots_token
columns.description: The token the entity's operator documents for robots.txt directives.

columns.name: ip_list_url
columns.description: URL of the vendor's published IP range list, when one exists.

columns.name: docs_url
columns.description: URL of the vendor's primary documentation for this entity.

columns.name: first_documented
columns.description: ISO date the entity was first documented by its vendor, when known.

columns.name: first_seen_here
columns.description: ISO date this site first logged a request from this entity.

columns.name: last_seen_here
columns.description: ISO date this site last logged a request from this entity.

columns.name: status
columns.description: One of active, retired, unverified.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Free-text identity notes about the entity. Policy facts live in claims, not here.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: ISO timestamp the row was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: ISO timestamp the row was last updated.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Numeric identifier for the claim, used in the claim URL pattern.

columns.name: entity_id
columns.description: The entities.id this claim is about.

columns.name: slug
columns.description: Optional URL-safe identifier for the claim.

columns.name: field
columns.description: The fact this claim states, for example respects_robots_txt.

columns.name: value
columns.description: The short typed value of the claim, for example yes, no, or a token.

columns.name: statement
columns.description: One canonical English sentence stating the fact.

columns.name: evidence_url
columns.description: Source URL the claim was verified against.

columns.name: evidence_quote
columns.description: A verbatim quote of 300 characters or fewer from the evidence URL.

columns.name: method
columns.description: One of vendor_doc, observed_here, third_party, test_here.

columns.name: verified_at
columns.description: ISO date this site checked the evidence URL.

columns.name: confidence
columns.description: One of high, medium, low.

columns.name: status
columns.description: One of current, superseded, disputed.

columns.name: supersedes_id
columns.description: The claims.id this claim replaces, when it supersedes an earlier claim.

columns.name: evidence_date
columns.description: ISO date the evidence source itself carries, when the source shows one.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: ISO timestamp the row was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: ISO timestamp the row was last updated.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Numeric identifier for the change row.

columns.name: claim_id
columns.description: The claims.id this change is about, when the change is about one claim.

columns.name: entity_id
columns.description: The entities.id this change is about.

columns.name: changed_at
columns.description: ISO timestamp (UTC) the change was recorded. Rows written before 2026-09-17 carry a date-only value backfilled to midnight UTC.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: One of new, updated, superseded, retired, disputed.

columns.name: old_value
columns.description: The claim value before the change, when applicable.

columns.name: new_value
columns.description: The claim value after the change, when applicable.

columns.name: evidence_url
columns.description: Source URL supporting the change, when one was recorded.

columns.name: note
columns.description: A free-text note about the change, written by a reviewer.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Numeric identifier for the daily rollup row.

columns.name: date
columns.description: ISO date the requests were counted on.

columns.name: entity_id
columns.description: The entities.id these requests are attributed to.

columns.name: requests
columns.description: Count of requests from this entity on this date.

columns.name: paths
columns.description: A JSON array of distinct paths requested, capped at 100 per day.

columns.name: formats
columns.description: A JSON array of distinct response formats served (html, md, json, txt, xml, csv).

columns.name: verified_share
columns.description: The share of this day's requests whose identity was verified against a published IP range or Cloudflare's verified-bot signal, from 0 to 1. To aggregate across days, sum verified_requests and requests separately and divide; averaging this column across days is not request-weighted.

columns.name: verified_requests
columns.description: Count of this day's requests whose identity was verified, the numerator of verified_share (verified_share = verified_requests / requests).

columns.name: id
columns.description: Numeric identifier for the question.

columns.name: ts_first
columns.description: ISO timestamp the question was first asked.

columns.name: ts_last
columns.description: ISO timestamp the question was most recently asked.

columns.name: text_norm
columns.description: The normalised text of the question: lowercase, punctuation stripped, lightly stemmed.

columns.name: count
columns.description: How many times this normalised question has been asked.

columns.name: sources
columns.description: A JSON array of sources the question arrived from, for example search, mcp, seeded, prompt_batch, note.

columns.name: matched_claim_ids
columns.description: A JSON array of claims.id values this question matched, when any did.

columns.name: gap
columns.description: 1 when no published claim matched the question, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Numeric identifier for the note.

columns.name: target_type
columns.description: One of claim, entity, question.

columns.name: target_id
columns.description: The id of the claim, entity, or question this note is about.

columns.name: body
columns.description: The text of the note, as submitted.

columns.name: author_claim
columns.description: Free text the submitter gave for who or what they are, for example a model, agent, or human.

columns.name: ts
columns.description: ISO timestamp the note was submitted.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Always published in this export; unpublished notes are never exported.

columns.name: date
columns.description: ISO date the calls were made on.

columns.name: tool
columns.description: The MCP tool name called, for example lookup_crawler.

columns.name: client_name
columns.description: The MCP client name reported at initialize, or unknown.

columns.name: calls
columns.description: Count of calls to this tool by this client on this date.

columns.name: avg_latency_ms
columns.description: Mean latency in milliseconds across these calls, rounded to the nearest integer.
